clauses.requirement: Where the specific test requirements of UN R10 Annex 9 paragraph 4 apply, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) of the rear lamp, such as the LED PCB, shall be tested in accordance with the specific test requirements set out in that paragraph.
Where radiated immunity testing of the rear lamp ESA is required, the absorber chamber test of UN R10 Annex 9 paragraph 4.1 shall be applied.
The absorber chamber test method shall test the rear lamp's electrical/electronic system (ESA) by exposing it to electromagnetic radiation generated by an antenna.
The absorber chamber test shall use the "substitution method" according to ISO 11452-2 to establish the test field conditions, and shall be performed with vertical polarization.

For ESAs in the configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the test arrangement shall be according to Appendix 3 to UN R10 Annex 9 (this applies only if the ESA is in that configuration).

For ESAs in the "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" configuration, the shielding configuration shall follow the vehicle series configuration; generally all shielded HV parts (e.g. AN, cables, connectors) shall be properly connected with low impedance to ground; ESAs and loads shall be connected to ground; the external HV power supply shall be connected via feed-through-filtering.

For ESAs in the "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" configuration, unless otherwise specified, the LV harness and HV harness length parallel to the front edge of the ground plane shall be 1,500 mm (±75 mm); the total test harness length including the connector shall be 1,700 mm (+300/-0 mm); the distance between the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 100 mm (+100/-0 mm).

For ESAs in the "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" configuration, all harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1,4) at 50 mm (±5 mm) above the ground plane.
